headline: Celesdir mount
title: Celesdir | Feybreak Alpha and Ride | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for a new ride in Palworld one point zero? Celesdir lives in the Feybreak region, and its alpha waits near the Crystalized Ancient Tree area. Expect a high level fight, somewhere in the fifties or sixties, so come prepared. Once you catch it and craft the saddle, you can ride it, and it is a top Lumbering worker too. Its partner skill even heals you. Will you ride it? Comment below!
description: Celesdir in Palworld 1.0 is a high level Feybreak alpha that you can ride and use as a strong lumberer.
